data.explanation: The county traffic authority (Kreis Beispielförde) has ordered you to keep a driving logbook (Fahrtenbuchauflage) for your vehicle BF-MU 412 for six months, because a traffic offense committed with this car on 14 July 2026 could not be traced to a specific driver. This is a formal administrative decision (Bescheid). If you disagree, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically, or in person at the Kreis office by the deadline shown — the app will calculate the exact date once you confirm when you received the letter. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final and you must keep the logbook (recording every trip, driver, date, start/end address) for the full six months once the decision is final; failing to comply can lead to fines. Consider getting legal advice if you want to contest the order.

items.action: Submit a written, electronic, or recorded objection (Widerspruch) to Kreis Beispielförde by the deadline shown if you want to contest the Fahrtenbuchauflage.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the order becomes final (bestandskräftig) and the logbook obligation takes effect.
